episodes.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
episodes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
episodes.blurb: A man insists he is not mad. He will prove it, calmly, by telling you how he murdered the old man with the vulture eye — and what he heard beneath the floor.
episodes.mood: Night, dread, a heart that will not stop
episodes.caption: “a pale blue eye, with a film over it”

episodes.title: The Masque of the Red Death
episodes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
episodes.blurb: A plague walks the land, so Prince Prospero seals a thousand friends inside his abbey and throws a masked ball. In the black chamber, a great ebony clock counts the hours.

episodes.title: The Sack of Rome
episodes.author: Edward Gibbon
episodes.blurb: August, 410. At midnight a gate in the walls of Rome opens from the inside, and for the first time in eight hundred years an enemy army is in the city. Gibbon's account of that night, with a documentary frame.
